description: Plankton provides a ROS 2 maritime-robotics simulation environment building on Gazebo and UUV Simulator. The provider is Liquid-ai / Plankton project. Geographical and temporal coverage: Users choose vehicle models, sensors and environmental conditions; configured scenarios determine coverage. The linked provider page supplies the access route and documentation; the resource payload was not retrieved. The licence is Apache-2.0. The described material is available without a stated fee. Caveats: Project ambitions about ease of use and sim-to-real transfer are not independent evidence of predictive accuracy. For simulation, the documented contents can support transport network modelling and capacity planning. This use is an interpretation of the metadata, not a tested integration. No directly related existing catalogue record was established.
